Options.OPTION_DESCRIPTION:ButtonLocatio: Where the button that opens the in-game Beyond Numbers settings panel is shown.
Options.OPTION_DESCRIPTION:HidePopulatio: Hides the population number until hovered.
Options.OPTION_DESCRIPTION:HideDemand: Hides the city demand until hovered.
Options.OPTION_DESCRIPTION:HideDate: Hides the in-game date / year until hovered.
Options.OPTION_DESCRIPTION:HideTime: Hides the in-game clock time until hovered.
BeyondNumbers.VisibilityPanel.Title: Beyond Numbers
BeyondNumbers.VisibilityPanel.CityWatchd: Disabled because City Watchdog is installed.
Options.OPTION_DESCRIPTION:ShowMoneyTren: Displays the hourly money change next to the cash value.
Displays the monthly money change next to the cash value.
Options.OPTION_DESCRIPTION:ShowPopTrendH: Displays the hourly population change next to the population value.
Options.OPTION_DESCRIPTION:ShowPopTrendM: Displays the monthly population change next to the population value.
Options.OPTION_DESCRIPTION:EnableMoneyTo: Shows a detailed breakdown when hovering the money value. Hidden and forced off when City Watchdog is installed.
Options.OPTION_DESCRIPTION:ShowTooltipIn: Includes total income in the money tooltip.
Options.OPTION_DESCRIPTION:ShowTooltipEx: Includes total expense in the money tooltip.
Options.OPTION_DESCRIPTION:ShowTooltipNe: Includes net (income minus expense) in the money tooltip.
Options.OPTION_DESCRIPTION:ShowTooltipHo: Displays values per hour in the tooltip.
Options.OPTION_DESCRIPTION:ShowTooltipMo: Displays values per month in the tooltip.
Options.OPTION_DESCRIPTION:EnablePopTool: Shows a detailed breakdown when hovering the population value. Hidden and forced off when City Watchdog is installed.
Options.OPTION_DESCRIPTION:PopTooltipMon: Includes the current monthly population trend in the tooltip.
Options.OPTION_DESCRIPTION:PopTooltipPop: Includes the total population in the tooltip.
Options.OPTION_DESCRIPTION:PopTooltipBir: Includes the monthly birth rate in the tooltip.
Options.OPTION_DESCRIPTION:PopTooltipDea: Includes the monthly death rate in the tooltip.
Options.OPTION_DESCRIPTION:PopTooltipMov: Includes citizens moved in per month in the tooltip.
Includes citizens moved away per month in the tooltip.
Options.OPTION_DESCRIPTION:PopTooltipJob: Includes the total number of jobs in the tooltip.
Options.OPTION_DESCRIPTION:PopTooltipEmp: Includes the number of employed citizens in the tooltip.
Options.OPTION_DESCRIPTION:PopTooltipUne: Includes the unemployment rate in the tooltip.
Options.OPTION_DESCRIPTION:PopTooltipHom: Includes the number of homeless citizens in the tooltip.
Includes the homelessness rate in the tooltip.
